g.text: the depends_on of docker-compose.yml and docker-compose.jad.yml: EDC 1.0 with siglet as its data plane (#927)
cfm: eclipse-cfm 0.0.8 from the mvhd fork, v0.0.8-mvhd.1 (ADR-085, ADR-088)
service_healthy: waits for the healthcheck to pass
service_started: waits for the container to start
service_completed_successfully: waits for the one-shot job to exit 0
a compose profile; the services in it start only with --profile <name>
a profile service's service_healthy on the default stack, written out rather than drawn
each of the six cfm7-*agent services waits for cfm7-nats on its own
no depends_on: neo4j, postgres, vault, nats, traefik, simpl-vault, cfm7-nats, neo4j-spe2
